newsitem.title: USA: Florida police arrest 42 teen-agers for drug dealing.
newsitem.headline: Florida police arrest 42 teen-agers for drug dealing.

text.p: Police arrested 42 Florida high school students on drug charges Friday after officers posed as pupils in a five-month sting operation, a Florida sheriff said.
Deputies detained the students on their way to school and on three high school campuses in the morning, Seminole County Sheriff Don Eslinger said.
Many of the students laughed as they were led past reporters at the county jail in Sanford, Florida.
"I've got nothing to worry about," one said. "My record's clean."
Two young police officers prepared for the assignment by studying how teenagers dressed and spoke. They attended class and waited until people began discussing their drug habits, Eslinger said.
The officers were able to buy all the marijuana, LSD, cocaine and ecstasy they wanted right on campus.
"This isn't the Cali Cartel or anything," Eslinger said. "But the idea is to provide a safe environment in the schools. Good kids shouldn't have to sit in rooms with drug dealers all day."
